messages:
maya: Quick design check — thinking about the 'Sample Projects' shelf on first-run. Two options: (A) curated picks we maintain (handpicked demos + product-aligned examples) or (B) auto-detect samples from connected repos / workspace and surface those. Which do we prefer for 1st-run vs later in the setup checklist?

jon: I lean curated for first-run. gives a consistent experience and we can optimize copy + screenshots.

sam: Curated makes infra simpler initially. Auto-detect will need permissions flow and an importer job.

lina: From research: new users get overwhelmed by too many choices. Curated reduces decision fatigue. But power users like seeing their own repo as an example.

maya: Good points. If curated is default, we could add an inline toggle: “Show my projects” in the setup checklist. That lets advanced users opt-in without blocking first-run. Thoughts on placement? top of quickstart banner vs inline in checklist step?

jon: Inline toggle in the checklist step feels less visually noisy. Banner should be action-oriented: "Try a sample project" CTA. Put the opt-in below the project list as a small secondary control — low friction.

chris: Accessibility nits: if we surface user repos we must ensure repository names aren't announced verbatim — use role and context. Also keyboard focus for the toggle MUST be before the list so screen reader users can change it without tabbing through many items.

maya: Good catch. So toggle first, then list. Also we discussed microcopy for the toggle: current draft: `Show my projects instead of samples`. Too clunky. Ideas?

jon: `Use my projects` is short but maybe ambiguous. `Show my repositories` is explicit but long. How about `Show my projects (private)` with a tooltip?

lina: In tests, users worry about privacy. Tooltip CTA should explain: "We only read repo names, not code. You can disconnect anytime." Keep it reassuring.

sam: Implementation note: opt-in triggers a background job: fetch repo names + detect language. Recommend we limit to first 10 repos and display a pagination for advanced view.

maya: Sounds reasonable. Another consideration: should curated samples be localized content (translated strings + screenshots) for EU/APAC regions?

jon: For MVP, prioritized curated EN only. But design should allow swapping copy assets per locale later. Make component support alt text for localized screenshots now.

chris: Accessibility: all screenshots need descriptive alt text and a visible focus outline on hover/focus for keyboard users. Also color contrast on the sample card badge (e.g., "python") is failing at AA for small text — need to bump contrast or use larger text.

jon: I'll update the token for badge BG to #1F3A93? and increase font size to 12px semibold.

maya: Quick poll: does product prefer curated default + opt-in auto-detect in checklist? @jon @sam @lina @chris react with :thumbsup: for yes, :thinking_face: for hold, :thumbsdown: for no

design-bot: poll created: https://poll.company/12345 (expires in 48h)

lina: +1 :thumbsup: — lean curated default.

sam: :thumbsup: from infra side.

jon: :thumbsup: — will push updated comps by EOD with accessibility fixes.

chris: :thinking_face: only on localization timeline; otherwise :thumbsup:. Need a follow-up ticket for AA contrast check across badges.

maya: Awesome. Action items: 1) Jon — update comps (badge contrast, alt text, toggle placement) 2) Sam — design backend job limits (top 10 + pagination) 3) Lina — craft tooltip microcopy and run 5 quick remote tests 4) Chris — create accessibility checklist for sample shelf

maya: I'll add these to the onboarding epic and link the poll results. Thanks everyone! :party_popper:
